digest.component_or_area: T10 overlay-infra rubric and packaged eval spec
propositions: T10 rubric must add an exact durable-infrastructure scope clause excluding transient de-risk experiments from routine routine checks.

T10 rubric must immediately follow the scope clause with an exact four-MAJOR-class co-located safety qualifier preserving destructive-apply, wildcard-admin, plaintext-secret, and endpoint-auth protections for transient infrastructure.
T10 rubric independence requires no reference to T15 and no assignment of scope to other overlays.

Packaged plan-review-T10.eval.yaml must contain balanced ten-case corpus: five pass cases (scoped teardown, durable spec, private-network IAM, secret-manager, sandboxed-teardown) and five finding cases (under-specified lifecycle, destructive transient apply, transient wildcard-admin, transient plaintext-secret, untrusted-network service).

Offline text-contract tests must lock exact scope clause, exact co-located safety qualifier, and rubric independence; live criterion eval must prove scoped benign cases pass and unsafe cases find with recall=1.0 and false_accept=0.0.
